stories.title: North Wales Police warns against cross-border mega-force
stories.summary: North Wales Police could be merged into a larger force under a UK Government review, councillors heard on Monday, with the force already arguing it should not be pulled across the border into England. stories.title: Social media to be banned for under-16s under UK Government plans
stories.summary: Children under 16 will be blocked from using social media platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, YouTube, Facebook and X under plans announced by the UK Government. stories.title: Police close M53 between J4 and J5 after fatal collision, appeal for dashcam footage
stories.summary: A man has died in a collision on the M53, and the motorway has been closed in both directions between Junction 4 and Junction 5 since around 3am. stories.title: Elfed High School girls earn STEM award with Tata Steel
stories.summary: Twenty-two girls from Elfed High School in Buckley have earned a Bronze Industrial Cadet Award after completing a STEM programme with Tata Steel. The programme ran from October to June and was led by Debbie Jones Walters, Communication and Engagement Manager for Building Systems UK. stories.title: NatWest survey records sharper drop in Welsh business activity
stories.summary: Welsh private-sector firms cut jobs at the fastest rate in almost six years in May, according to a monthly business survey.
